reviews.text: Imagine your pet suffering an accident, being neglected, and you only finding out about it after it has passed away. It's sad, isn't it? Tina's owners will never forget.

A place that has a lot of dedication and love, I just have to thank all the Aunties and Uncle for the affection and care they have for my princess Mila, she loves going to daycare, she arrives every day grumbling to go in.
I constantly receive photos and videos of her happy and having fun with her doggy friends, my heart is filled with joy ❤️

I simply love all the care they give our children. I went to several daycares and none offer the same environment, activities, and attention. If it's hot, they stay outdoors. If it's cold/rainy, they go indoors. They always keep our pets active. There's one closer to me, cheaper, but I wouldn't trade it for anything! I highly recommend it!

Bisnaga just had her first day of adaptation at daycare, and I found everything very well organized, from the service to the experience itself!

They let me see the whole space, the little corners where she'll play, and even the adaptation was done in a super strategic and careful way: introducing one dog at a time, so she could gradually get used to the place and feel safe.

As soon as I arrived, they created a WhatsApp group to share all the photos and keep track of how she was doing. I felt that everything was conducted with great responsibility by a truly professional team. Plus, the owners are extremely welcoming!

I left there certain that I found a place where Bisnaga will be able to play a lot and, most importantly, safely 🤍

I'm sure she already feels at home... and I'm already eager to start the plan and take her there more often!!!

I love Dog Parque Juventude, they are extremely careful with Filó, as well as flexible and attentive to the owners.

I feel very comfortable leaving her there, she comes back happy and full of doggy friends!!

Excellent daycare! The care, affection, and attention given to Bruce Lee are truly exceptional. We were very satisfied with the service and the entire Dog Parque facility. And, judging by how Bruce returns home, he's loving it too! 🐶❤️ I highly recommend it!

A great daycare! Our dog loves it! She's treated with lots of affection and plays a lot on the days she goes!

We feel at ease while she's there!

I highly recommend it!

Jorge (dog), 8 months old, is my favorite place. The environment is super pleasant for my pet and the facilities are very good too. Excellent service ✨ I highly recommend it; Jorge goes to daycare 3 times a week.

I've been leaving my dogs at Dog Parque for years, and I wouldn't trade it for any other place. Their affection and attention are unbeatable, and we receive feedback all day long. It's like we're right there with the animals! Highly recommended!

We arranged to leave our dog at a certain time, and after two and a half hours, the service hadn't even started, leaving the dog locked up the entire time. The reason given was a power outage, which wasn't communicated at any point. After we expressed our dissatisfaction, the person complained that we have no patience and that they can't handle customer complaints.
They take care of the pets with so much love! I loved it!
The attendant was rude, and it's not even on the website that they don't work with cats 🐱. …
The best place in the north zone for you to entrust your pet to.

My dog ​​and I love it there, the space is super welcoming and cozy, the staff are always very friendly, and she comes back from her bath looking beautiful and smelling wonderful. She loves it there, I recommend it without hesitation!

I felt safe leaving my dog ​​Annie in the care of the Dog Parque staff so I could travel for a few days. I received daily photos and videos to keep track of her. Annie had a blast! I'll need their dog hotel service again. I highly recommend them. The service was friendly.
Very good. Excellent security, the staff is very caring and responsible with the animals. I leave my dog ​​there without worry. I recommend it.

Excellent quality daycare and boarding. This is the second time I've left my dog ​​there because of travel. The staff is very careful and professional, and very affectionate with the furry friends. I highly recommend them.

A welcoming place, my third pet to stay there. Sensational service, they keep you informed 24/7 sending videos and photos. Margô already recognizes us on the street and gets so excited when she arrives. She's received with so much affection by everyone. I highly recommend it ❤️
The staff are so loving and always warm our hearts with photos of the furry friends throughout the day! My pets love being there!

Wonderful, super organized, beautiful. I always leave my dogs there when I travel. I trust them completely, the care is perfect. They love going to Aunt Pati's.
The team is wonderful, they take care of them, play with them, and even pet them. They send photos and joke around. I highly recommend them. You can trust them, Eliana.

Dog Parque da Juventude is simply amazing! They are extremely special and take care of Sol in the best way possible. We trust their work, affection, and dedication to all the dogs completely — including, of course, our Sol.
Sol is in love with the monitor Eve: she always wants to be held, receives a lot of love, and goes home happy and calm. It's clear how welcomed she feels there.
We wholeheartedly recommend it! It's a place where we know Sol is safe, loved, and very well cared for.

I visited Dog Parque last year, my dog ​​Escher loved it. He hadn't been for a while because he needed to be neutered (which I think was absolutely right), but he went back this week and left very happy. The treatment is great, I love it.

My little black dog loves daycare, she even knows the days she goes there, haha. The care and playtime are amazing, I can leave her there without worries. She burns off energy and plays with her friends! When she arrives, it's pure joy. They constantly send photos of her activities, and we can follow along with our pets' daily routine. I highly recommend Dog Parque da Juventude.
An extraordinary place!
Extremely attentive, in constant contact with photos and information about the meals.
Super attentive and dedicated to our four-legged children.
The best place for my sweetheart to stay. He loves it.

We travel and for several years now we've left our dogs at Dog Parque! We have complete trust in them; the dogs get distracted, burn off a lot of energy, and interact with others; they play, run, and have a lot of fun! We receive photos, videos, and updates throughout our trip, and we love it! I highly recommend it!
Thanks
It needs improvement.

The experience was going well… until today. There were no complaints, and I always tried to act transparently whenever possible.
But I don't tolerate disrespect towards my dog, much less towards me! Arriving at the place and seeing your dog in the dark, locked in a stuffy room and barking desperately. And then being questioned because I made a face like I didn't understand what was happening…
If someone does this to your property, knowing that you will soon arrive to find it and may witness it, what might they do when we are not around? It's something to think about.
Disappointment is the word… but I'm sure there are still good, competent people there who value respectful work…
They are incredibly special. My elderly dog, who needs care, is treated with all the attention she needs, and with so much love. You can trust the work of this wonderful place!
Excellent and trustworthy environment for pets! They are extremely careful with the dogs.
🥰 Thank you for your review! …
We loved it.
Wonderful!!! I'm confirmed every week at this incredible place, they take wonderful care of my dog, always with care and love.
We loved our experience with Dog Parque. They are always helpful and send photos and videos all the time to keep us updated on how our pets are doing.

I always take Frida Maria with me; she suffers from anxiety and is extremely well cared for by everyone, with lots of affection and responsibility. They always send photos and videos of how she's doing, which she loves, and whenever she arrives at the door she's eager to go inside to see her doggy friends.
Dog Parque is simply sensational, Thor absolutely loves this place. The service, affection, and care they have for the dogs is extraordinary. I highly recommend it.

In short...there's a lot of love involved with our pet here, there's no shortage of affection, attention, care, and I even receive lots of photos that brighten my day.
I highly recommend it 🥰 …
